food_identity: Southern coastal food destination combining fresh-catch seafood, beach BBQ, home-style Sri Lankan rice-and-curry, roti/kottu shops, cooking experiences and a large tourism-oriented cafe/bar scene.
best_use_cases: fresh seafood dinners,budget local curries,roti/kottu,beach dining,cooking classes,vegetarian breakfast
notable_food_areas: Mirissa Beach,Udupila/inland Mirissa,Bandaramulla,central A2/Galle Road corridor
social_insights: Popularity and beachfront location often correlate with tourist orientation, while home-style curry and roti shops can offer stronger local-food signals. The recommender should keep authenticity, atmosphere, price and popularity as separate dimensions.
